'''Xavier Pérez Font''' (born 15 January 1968) is an Andorran former [[Cycle sport|cyclist]]. He competed at the [[1988 Summer Olympics]] and the [[1992 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/pe/xavier-perez-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418122526/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/pe/xavier-perez-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Xavier Pérez Olympic Results |access-date=5 July 2016}}</ref> He also rode in the [[1993 Giro d'Italia]], but failed to finish.
